Patch 1.18 · Frostbite — live Nov 3

Role. Hero. Build. Done.

Tap a role, tap a hero — the build is right there, counters included. No digging through menus, no community tabs, no five clicks deep.

STEP 1

Pick your role

One tap. The heroes for that role show up below.

STEP 2

Pick your hero

Full roster — all 56 heroes, Patch 1.18.

What “tier” means: how strong a hero is in ranked games right now. Must Use = the strongest picks this patch. S is close behind, then A, then B. Works the same on PC, PlayStation and Xbox.

STEP 3

Your build

Items in order, crest, augments, Eternals, which ability to level first — and who counters you, on the same panel.

New to Predecessor? Read this first

Every word on this board, in plain language. If a build ever uses a word you don’t know, it’s explained here — no experience needed.

Role

Your job in the match. Carry deals the damage late, Support protects the Carry, Midlane holds the middle lane, Jungle roams the wild areas, Offlane holds a side lane alone.

Build

The list of items to buy, in order. You buy items with gold you earn during the match. Buy item 1 first, then 2, and so on — the order is the whole point.

Crest

A bonus item every hero gets for free at the start. As the match goes on it grows into a stronger second form — that’s the second name shown.

Augment

A small extra power-up you pick for your hero before the match starts. It tweaks one part of how your hero plays, and it is on from the first minute.

Ability

Your hero’s special moves. Every hero has an Alternate, a Primary and a Secondary ability, plus one big Ultimate. The build panel shows which ones to make stronger first — by name, so it reads the same on PC, PlayStation and Xbox.

Eternal

One of 12 gods you pick before the match. Your Eternal gives you one big Major Blessing that lasts all game, plus two smaller Minor Blessings you choose. All 12 unlock at player level 10.

Counter pick

A hero who is strong against another hero. The counters shown with each build are the heroes who give that hero the hardest time.

Coming later — community builds

Phase 2, on purpose. Launch stays clean: verified board only, no accounts, no submission spam to wade through. When the community shelf opens, it runs on its own rules:

Its own shelf, clearly stamped

Community builds live beside the board, always labeled “Community — unverified.” They never blend into the verified panel.

Likes float, dislikes bury

Every community build carries its author and patch stamp. Votes sort the shelf, and a new patch flags old builds stale on its own.

Votes can’t buy “verified”

A thousand likes still don’t open the verified door. That only opens with real high-ranked match evidence — popular and proven stay two different things.

How “verified” works here: a build or counter earns the green Verified stamp only from real high-ranked match evidence. Until then it shows as a board build, pending verification — nothing gets the stamp for free. Tier snapshot reflects ranked data pulled Nov 20, 2026.
